head.title: Four practices,|one *pause*.
head.lead: Every session is one-to-one and begins with a conversation. If you are not sure which to choose, that first conversation is exactly what it is for.

items.question: How do I choose the right practice?
items.answer: You do not need to arrive with a decision. In a free first conversation of up to 20 minutes, we talk about where you are and choose together where to begin.

items.question: Do I need any experience with meditation or integrative therapies?
items.answer: No. Every practice is guided step by step and adapted to your pace, including for people who have never tried any of them.

items.question: Do online sessions work?
items.answer: Guided meditation works very well over video. Practices that involve touch, such as somatic therapy, reiki and aromatherapy, take place in person only.

items.question: How often should I come?
items.answer: It depends on what you are looking for. Many people start with weekly sessions for a month and then space them out. Nothing is sold as a package: you decide each time.

items.question: What if I need to cancel?
items.answer: Just let us know 24 hours in advance to reschedule at no cost.

items.question: Do these practices replace medical or psychological treatment?
items.answer: No. Integrative practices complement, and do not replace, medical or psychological care. If you are in treatment, it remains your main reference.

closing.title: Still *unsure*?
closing.text: Tell us how you are arriving. In the first conversation, we choose together the practice that makes the most sense right now.
